_note: Install with uv sync --extra minihack. Custom MiniHack layout; no monsters or traps. Unfilled water cannot be entered; boulder filling retains native randomness. The seed reproduces a tested route, not every possible action sequence.

text: Reach the staircase. Plan the order of your pushes.
